stories.title: Iran claims strike on unmanned US vessel in Strait of Hormuz as fighting escalates
stories.summary: Iran said it struck an unmanned US vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, the latest salvo in a resurgent conflict with the US around the key shipping chokepoint. The US has not confirmed the claim, and the strike follows US action on Iranian oil tankers.

stories.title: US strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying warships were targeted with ballistic missiles
stories.summary: The US military reported striking three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships had come under ballistic missile fire. The exchange marks a sharp escalation in the renewed Iran-US conflict.

stories.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
stories.summary: The US and Iran exchanged retaliatory strikes on ships, the latest round since fighting flared a week ago after a month of relative calm. The Strait of Hormuz is the focus of the renewed hostilities.

stories.title: Berlin launches crisis response after hackers publish stolen state data
stories.summary: Berlin said it is urgently reviewing a 5.79TB data release by the Rhysida ransomware group after refusing to pay a ransom, with files reportedly including national defense and threat-response plans. The leak is a major breach of German state infrastructure.

stories.title: The Army just used a 20-kilowatt laser to take out three drones
stories.summary: The US Army tested a 20-kilowatt directed-energy weapon that destroyed three drones in a single engagement, a step forward for low-cost counter-drone defense. The system offers a cheaper alternative to interceptor missiles.

stories.title: Second complete map of a fruit fly brain completed
stories.summary: Researchers finished a complete connectome of a male fruit fly brain, joining the earlier female fly map and giving neuroscientists a view of brain wiring that may inform AI and neural-computing research. It is a landmark in whole-brain mapping.

stories.title: The data center backlash is challenging Texas
stories.summary: Texas, which has profited for 30 years from data center growth, is facing a mounting community and political backlash over the power and water demands of AI-scale facilities. The tensions could reshape where hyperscale projects are sited.

stories.title: Sunday Dawg Chow: final Sunday before the Browns' season opener
stories.summary: The latest Cleveland Browns news roundup lands on the final Sunday before the team's Week 1 opener at Jacksonville, tying together roster, injury and game-plan notes. With Deshaun Watson confirmed as starter, the focus shifts to how the offense will open the season.

stories.title: Ohio State routs Ball State, ready for 'monster game' at Texas
stories.summary: No. 1 Ohio State opened its season with a 56-3 rout of Ball State, then immediately turned attention to next week's trip to No. 5 Texas. Coach Ryan Day gave the team 15 minutes to celebrate before pivoting to the marquee road game, which he called a 'monster game.'

stories.title: Smith and Sayin help No. 1 Ohio State prepare for Texas with 56-3 rout of Ball State
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith and quarterback Julian Sayin connected early, including a season-opening touchdown, as top-ranked Ohio State cruised past Ball State 56-3. The Buckeyes scored on eight of 11 post-first-drive possessions ahead of their Texas showdown.

stories.title: No. 1 Ohio State rolls past Ball State 56-3 ahead of Texas clash
stories.summary: Ohio State went three-and-out on its opening drive but found the end zone on seven of its next nine possessions in a 56-3 win over Ball State. The dominant opener sets up next week's trip to Texas.

stories.title: Ohio State dominates 2026 opener in 56-3 win over Ball State, replay
stories.summary: Ohio State rolled to a 56-3 season-opening win over Ball State, with highlights and analysis in the Columbus Dispatch's full recap. The Buckeyes used the straightforward win to build momentum before facing Texas.

stories.title: Final starting grid for the 2026 Italian Grand Prix after penalties
stories.summary: Pierre Gasly took a shock maiden pole at Monza, the first French pole since Jean Alesi in 1997, edging George Russell by under a tenth as Ferrari missed home pole with Leclerc fourth and Hamilton fifth. The grid is set for Sunday's race at the Temple of Speed.

stories.title: Italian Grand Prix 2026: start time, how to watch and schedule
stories.summary: The Italian Grand Prix at Monza runs Sunday afternoon, serving as an important European home race for Ferrari. The guide lays out start time, TV coverage and what to watch with Gasly on pole.

stories.title: Central Ohio law enforcement and hospitals report phone service interruptions
stories.summary: Central Ohio law enforcement agencies and hospitals reported phone service interruptions affecting 911 and regular lines in parts of the region. Officials advised residents to use alternate contact routes while the outages were investigated.

stories.title: Former Columbus police officer pleads guilty in fatal shooting of Donovan Lewis
stories.summary: Former Columbus police officer Ricky Anderson pleaded guilty in the deadly 2023 shooting of Donovan Lewis, having faced murder and reckless homicide charges. The plea moves a high-profile central Ohio police accountability case toward sentencing.

stories.title: Ohio families face utility disconnections amid rising electric rates
stories.summary: Ohio families are increasingly facing utility disconnections as electric rates climb, straining household budgets around central Ohio. The trend highlights growing affordability pressure on the region's residents.

stories.title: 17-year-old killed in Morrow County crash
stories.summary: A 17-year-old was killed in a crash on County Road 170 in Morrow County. Authorities were investigating the circumstances of the fatal accident.
